card.name: Linking words before a medical condition
card.fires_on: Short linking words or verbs such as rather, accompanied, tend, prevent right before a condition or symptom term like hypoglycemia, hypokalemia or a manic episode. It is most often seen in warnings and interaction text.

modes.label: Rather than
modes.description: The word 'rather' after a symptom, just before 'than' and a contrasting sign.
modes.example: Marked mydriasis<< rather>> than miosis may be seen with hyp

modes.label: Verb before a condition
modes.description: A verb or participle that leads into a named disorder or effect.
modes.example: WARNINGS Severe cases of hyponatremia,<< accompanied>> by hypokalemia have been reported

modes.label: Prevent an episode
modes.description: The word prevent or episode in a sentence about treating mania.
modes.example: antipsychotics to help<< prevent>> a manic episode.

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words that come just before a named medical condition or symptom.
